sql: with o as (select market_ticker t, sum(case when action='buy' then limit_price*quantity else 0 end)/100.0 bought, sum(case when action='sell' then limit_price*quantity else 0 end)/100.0 sold, string_agg(side||' '||action||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity, ' | ' order by created_at) legs from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status='filled' group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker t, quantity q, realized_pnl r, (raw_json ? 'settled_time') st from positions where market_ticker in (select t from o) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select o.t, o.bought, o.sold, p.q, p.r, p.st, o.legs from o left join p using (t) order by o.t
